verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox for testing the API without affecting live production data. It has its own frontend (demo.ramp.com) and API base (demo-api.ramp.com), and demo accounts move no real money. A simulation panel (⌘ J) can pay bills, mark reimbursements paid and add transactions. The agent channels support it too: the CLI connects to the sandbox by default, and Ramp MCP has a separate demo-data endpoint (demo-mcp.ramp.com). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox and demo endpoints work as documented, since the probes only exercised the production and developer MCP servers.
